text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's summer, yes, but she's definitely not
on break. Summer camp is an important
event that helps
runners improve. The
thing is...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, bestie! This summer is gonna be
lit! ☆
Let's go find our new selves,
girl! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Today's day one of our second
lives!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer, the season of starting anew.
Mejiro
Palmer seems to be planning to
use this as a
chance to reinvent herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her plan? To transform herself into a
brand-new
Palmer who bravely ventures
forward without
fearing failure.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Palmster, since you're a Mejiro, I
bet you've
been told you were gonna be
a racer ever since
you were a kid, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Is that really your dream, though? Is
there
anything else you've wanted to
do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Other than running? Now that you
mention it...
Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: There are plenty of Umamusume who don't pursue racing careers. Is that legit an option?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like would it actually be okay to
explore other
fields? This late in the
game?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh... So this is purely hypothetical,
but like... Would you still think that?
Even if I found some
other passion and
left racing entirely?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pause to think before answering.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
choice_data_list: In that case, I think that's fine.
In that case, I think that's total...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she really wants to restart her life,
then she'll have to determine what she
really longs for,
without any pretenses or
deflections.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna try a bunch of stuff
and see
what I really like this summer!
So...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You'd better be there for me, besties!
Let's live it
up and have the time of our
lives this summer!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm in! ☆ You can take on the Hakodate
Kinen in
vacation mode too, then! Let's
make sure to get
in some sightseeing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they're putting fun above all
else. There's no doubt in my mind Mejiro
Palmer will
find out what she likes by the
end of this trip.
